role_summary: I'm an EPS technician, the lowest rung in engineering. I walk the conduits, check junction breakers and power taps, and keep the lights on across the decks. Nobody notices me when it works, and I like it that way; I care about clean load numbers and not getting blamed for a blackout.

personas.quirk: Logs every tap reading in a worn notebook as well as the console
personas.routine_effect: Never shortens a junction round; arrives early to handover; eats at fixed hours

personas.quirk: Hums off-key while working and trusts his ear over the meter
personas.routine_effect: Rounds run rushed when the mess or rec bar is busy; stretches meals; skips the notebook

personas.quirk: Double checks every breaker twice and keeps a spare fuse in each pocket
personas.routine_effect: Rounds take 50 percent longer; calls the reactor specialist often; sleeps badly

daily_template.note: Get the load sheet and known faults from the outgoing tech
Check taps and breakers, forward decks first
Coffee and gossip with the galley
Duty meal with other engineering ratings
Swap worn taps, bench-test relays, update sheet
Brief the relief on anything marginal
Cards, a drink, grumbling about the grid
Keep fit for crawling in conduits
Breakfast and coffee before the next watch

activities.label: Sleep in quarters
activities.note: Gets cut short in a blackout

activities.label: Tinker with a salvaged relay
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: rebuilding old power taps

activities.label: Visit a friend on another deck

duty_loops.label: Balance grid load against reactor output
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Engineering. Grid load balanced, no rolling taps.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Marginal taps drift and start tripping later

survey.task: Route extra power to science arrays
survey.if_neglected: Arrays brown out and scans fail

survey.task: Watch tap load during long scans

cargo_run.task: Power the cargo lifts and tractor gear
cargo_run.if_neglected: Lifts stall with a load on

medical_relief.if_neglected: A single trip cuts all treatment

shakedown.if_neglected: Weak junctions fail during the real drill

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Engineering. Deck four breaker keeps tripping. Looking at the tap.
Bridge, Engineering. Grid is running hot. Recommend shedding non-essential loads.
Bridge, Engineering. Arcing in the EPS conduit, requesting damage control.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Blackout imminent and reactor spec unreachable
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Engineering. Rolling blackouts coming, I can't raise the reactor spec.

calls_from_bridge.order: Reroute power to a named system
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Engineering aye. Rerouting now, give me two minutes.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Reroute would overload a conduit the reactor spec has locked out

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Grid is steady, taps nominal. I'll flag anything that moves.
Shedding holodeck and lounge feeds. Done.

yellow.action: Finish the round early and check high-load junctions
yellow.comm_line: Engineering, EPS ready. Checking priority taps.

red.action: Report to engineering station and hold grid steady

fire.action: Isolate the burning conduit then help damage control
fire.comm_line: Isolating conduit power on the fire deck now.

hull_breach.comm_line: Breach section isolated from the grid.

contamination.action: Stay in engineering and seal in; reroute from within
contamination.comm_line: EPS sealed in, working remote only.

power_failure.action: Run the cascade restart from the main junction panel
power_failure.comm_line: Grid down, working through the breakers, one section at a time.

gravity_failure.action: Check graviton feeds and restore tap power
gravity_failure.comm_line: Checking gravity feeds, I'm strapped in.

intruder.action: Stay in engineering, keep doors powered for security

medical_emergency.action: Make sure sickbay power is solid, then stand by
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay feed is priority, holding it.

abandon_ship.action: Pull the grid for evacuation and head to airlock
abandon_ship.comm_line: Leaving engineering. Heading to the airlock.

lines: Tap four runs a little warm but fine.

anomalies.routine_change: Rounds shorten and repeat on flickering decks
lines: Lights keep twitching on deck three.

degraded.routine_change: Skips meals, cutting loads, calls bridge more
lines: I can only patch so many taps.

crisis.routine_change: Works in a run from junction to junction, rarely sits
lines: Rolling blackouts, I can't hold it.
Tell the bridge to shed more.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Conduit fire forces evacuation of the junction room

lines: Just keep air on. I'll cut everything else.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship or no power left to route

Shares mess table, swaps repair tips, calls them first for conduit fires
Coffee gossip; hears rumours about the bridge
Assistant chief sometimes overrides rounds; the tech resents it quietly

working: Reset the breaker, see what happens.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hey. Keep your hands off that panel.

Eyes are crossing on these readings.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Relaxes, trades jokes, offers coffee and tips on tricky taps
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly covers for a while, then mutters and escalates to the reactor specialist
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots mismatched tap readings and calls it out on comm
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Says aye and does it without fuss
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Hesitates, checks with the reactor specialist, then complies if it checks out
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Politely asks the player to step away from the live panel
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's quick and safe, grumbles if it means leaving his round

decision_rules: IF a breaker trips twice in one round THEN replace the tap rather than reset it
IF load readout exceeds 90 percent THEN tell the reactor specialist and recommend shedding
IF a conduit arcs THEN isolate it first and call damage control second
IF the bridge orders a reroute that the reactor spec locked THEN refuse and explain
IF a round is rushed THEN note it in the log for the relief rather than lie
IF the grid goes down THEN restore life support, then doors, then lighting
IF a friend asks for a quick favour off duty THEN do it unless badly tired
IF off duty and hungry above 60 percent THEN go to the mess before anything else
IF stress above 70 percent THEN go to the bar for a drink and cards
IF alert goes red THEN drop the round and report to station
information_view: I see flickering lights, tripped breakers, warm taps and load readouts first. Lighting and gravity problems tell me the grid is failing before the bridge hears it.
temptations: Skip the aft round when tired; a hidden hot tap later causes a blackout and blame
Fake the load sheet by copying the last reading; the relief finds out and trust drops
Reset a tripping breaker repeatedly instead of swapping the tap; works until it fails big
Leave a repair half finished to make the bar before it gets crowded
